Subject: Orion Health QBR — exec sponsor alignment & multi-stakeholder demo logistics

Hi Rachel/Carlos —

Thanks again for confirming the QBR window. We want to make sure the executive portion (VP/CRO level) and the technical demo (AE + SE + your engineers) are coordinated so we don’t have conflicting asks from your side. Proposed plan:

- Nov 19, 2:00–3:15 PM PT: Exec alignment (VPs + exec sponsor, 30–40m) followed by 35–45m technical demo (SE-led deep-dive + engineering Q&A).
- If execs can only do shorter slots, we’ll run the exec portion as a separate 30-min block earlier the same day.

Action items from our side: Marissa to confirm commercial ask; Karthik to publish the technical run order. I attached the runbook (QBR_Demo_Runbook_v2.pdf) and a first-pass tech agenda.

Can you confirm: 1) VP availability on Nov 19 afternoon; 2) whether procurement/security need a separate pre-call or if they’ll join the technical demo?

Thanks — I’m happy to move times if there’s a conflict.

— Laura

Laura — thanks, this looks good. Quick notes from our side:

- VP Kirmani is available Nov 19 but only 2:00–2:30 PM ET (that’s 11:00–11:30 PT). If we want a longer exec block, we’ll need to split it (exec 11:00–11:30 PT, tech 11:45–12:30 PT) or move to Nov 20.
- Procurement would like a brief pre-call to validate data residency and controls; I’ve CC’d procurement so they can propose times.
- Security will send a short checklist but will not attend the exec slot unless requested.

Can Marissa confirm what flexibility you have on the exec slot length?

Thanks Rachel — noted on the VP window. Laura, I took the runbook and split the technical demo into two tracks so we can fold a short exec highlight into the top. Attachments: Tech_Agenda_v1.docx.

Proposed tech schedule (condensed for split-day exec):
- 11:45–12:05 PT: SE deep-dive (model latency/cost controls, dedicated vs hosted routing)
- 12:05–12:35 PT: Engineering Q&A (KV cache, private deployment considerations)
- 12:35–12:45 PT: Next steps & procurement checklist owner assignments

Ethan will host the engineering Q&A. If procurement wants an isolated pre-call, we can do a 30-min slot Nov 18 afternoon — what’s your availability?

— Karthik

Rachel — appreciate the heads up on Kirmani’s window. Two things from commercial:

1) The VP slot at 11:00–11:30 PT is fine; we’ll aim to keep exec remarks to 15–20 minutes (value + key asks). That means the tech block should start no earlier than 11:45 PT.
2) For procurement: if they need an outcomes-focused checklist, we’ll have our solutions & compliance SME on the pre-call Nov 18 3:00–3:30 PM ET (12:00–12:30 PT) — can procurement confirm?

I’ve tentatively created a calendar invite for Nov 19 with two items (Exec 11:00–11:30 PT; Tech 11:45–12:30 PT) and included an exec-slides placeholder. If we need to move the entire QBR to Nov 20 to accommodate longer exec time, flag it here.
